items.title: How Olipop hit $500M in revenue and beat Pepsi's Poppi: Fmr CEO
items.summary: Olipop Co-Founder and former CEO Ben Goodwin breaks down to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi the brand's massive $500 million growth, how they reclaimed the top spot from Poppi, and why health-conscious consumers ultimately don't trust Big Soda giants like Coke and Pepsi. Ben Goodwin was still the CEO of Olipop at the time of this recording.
